RED LENTIL SOUP
Serves 6

2 Tbsp olive oil
1 large onion, chopped
2 carrots, diced
3 garlic cloves, minced
2 c. red lentils, rinsed
8 c. vegetable broth
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes
2 tsp ground cumin
Juice of 1 lemon
Salt to taste

1. Warm the olive oil in a large pot and cook the onion and carrots 6 minutes.
2. Add the garlic and cumin; cook 1 minute.
3. Add the red lentils, vegetable broth and diced tomatoes. Simmer 25 minutes.
4. Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt.
